import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;

    static class Edge {
        int dest, back;
        long flow, capacity, weight;
        
        Edge(int dest, int back, long flow, long capacity, long weight) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.back = back;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.weight = weight;
        }
    }

    static Edge[][] network = new Edge[5000][5000];
    static int[] nodeDegree = new int[5000];
    static long totalExpense;

    static void clearNetwork(int size) {
        totalExpense = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            nodeDegree[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 5000; ++j) {
                network[i][j] = null;
            }
        }
    }

    static void link(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
        totalExpense = Math.max(totalExpense, cap);
        network[from][nodeDegree[from]] = new Edge(to, nodeDegree[to], 0, cap, cost);
        nodeDegree[from]++;
        network[to][nodeDegree[to]] = new Edge(from, nodeDegree[from] - 1, 0, 0, -cost);
        nodeDegree[to]++;
    }

    static boolean[] marked = new boolean[5000];
    static int[] predecessor = new int[5000];
    static long[] height = new long[5000];
    static long[] shortest = new long[5000];

    static void heightSetup(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(height, 0, n, 0);
        for (int iter = 1; iter < n; ++iter) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeDegree[u]; ++i) {
                    Edge e = network[u][i];
                    if (e != null && e.capacity > 0) {
                        if (height[e.dest] > height[u] + e.weight) {
                            height[e.dest] = height[u] + e.weight;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long relax(int source, int target, long[] totalCost, int nodeCount, boolean useQueue) {
        Arrays.fill(marked, 0, nodeCount, false);
        Arrays.fill(shortest, 0, nodeCount, INF);
        shortest[source] = 0;

        if (useQueue) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (marked[u]) continue;
                marked[u] = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeDegree[u]; ++i) {
                    Edge e = network[u][i];
                    if (e != null && e.flow < e.capacity && shortest[e.dest] > shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight) {
                        shortest[e.dest] = shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight;
                        predecessor[e.dest] = i;
                        q.offer(e.dest);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int u = source; u != -1; ) {
                marked[u] = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeDegree[u]; ++i) {
                    Edge e = network[u][i];
                    if (e != null && e.flow < e.capacity && shortest[e.dest] > shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight) {
                        shortest[e.dest] = shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight;
                        predecessor[e.dest] = i;
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
                    if (!marked[i] && shortest[i] < best) {
                        best = shortest[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (shortest[target] >= INF) return 0;

        long bottleneck = INF;
        for (int node = target; node != source; ) {
            int idx = predecessor[node];
            Edge rev = network[node][idx];
            Edge fwd = network[rev.dest][rev.back];
            bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, fwd.capacity - fwd.flow);
            node = rev.dest;
        }

        for (int node = target; node != source; ) {
            int idx = predecessor[node];
            Edge rev = network[node][idx];
            Edge fwd = network[rev.dest][rev.back];
            fwd.flow += bottleneck;
            rev.flow -= bottleneck;
            totalCost[0] += bottleneck * fwd.weight;
            node = rev.dest;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
            height[i] = Math.min(INF, shortest[i] + height[i]);
        }
        return bottleneck;
    }

    static long minCostFlow(int source, int target, long[] totalCost, int nodeCount, boolean useQueue) {
        heightSetup(nodeCount);
        long totalFlow = 0;
        totalCost[0] = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = relax(source, target, totalCost, nodeCount, useQueue);
            if (df == 0) break;
            totalFlow += df;
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;

        clearNetwork(sink + 1);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            link(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            link(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    link(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    link(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    link(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = minCostFlow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
